svg.title: Plant model case F-07: EPS fault (LKA_STATE 9) with loss of EPS assist
svg.desc: Synthetic data (DSR-12), no evidence credit. Top-down lane view with the ego path, lateral deviation against time with the 0.5 s SG-01 FTTI band and the lane-line thresholds 0.61 m and 0.96 m, and the event timeline from fault onset.
svg.text: F-07 · EPS fault (LKA_STATE 9) with loss of EPS assist
curve road, 110 km/h, EPS-release assumption, driver t_r = 1.5 s. FMEA SFM-005; WP-V-05 VS-FI-31.
A · Top-down lane view (road straightened, lateral scale exaggerated)
car centre with the body edge on the lane line (0.96 m)
ego outline from the purchased mesh (18-inch wheels: sport trim)
B · Lateral deviation from the offset at fault onset (m) against time from fault onset (s)
clipped at ±2 m; maximum -3.43 m at 3.13 s
panda refuses STEERING_LKA 0.01 s · authority revoked 0.05 s
